title: .knowledge/ record front matter, schema 1
description: The shape of a record's front matter, read as JSON (SEMANTICS.md §The record). Passing this schema does not make a record valid. It cannot express: that every string is single-quoted and knowledge is the one plain integer; hidden text and conflict markers; the body (present, not empty); duplicate keys, anchors, aliases, tags and merge keys; paths (confinement, the empty path, a config_key glob directory) and the config_key key-path grammar; the 8 KiB front matter and 64 KiB file bounds. Unknown keys are legal: an x- key is ignored and any other is reported once.

id.description: 12 Crockford base32 characters, lower case; an id beginning 0000 is reserved for documentation.

check.description: One verb; at most one anchor; text only with code. A check with no known anchor is an unknown check kind, legal when it has another key (an x- key does not count, which this schema cannot express).
